Name: Master Brewer
Author: GrobFaraona
Description:
This mod adds various types of Alcohols that you can brew!.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https.//https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970?tab=description] install the latest version of PFM[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720] install the latest version of JA[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348] install the latest version of Spacecore[/url]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
The first Machines that you will need to start brewing your brews, are available at Gus's saloon for purchase.
To make flavoured Vodka, you need to first purchase the Homemade Extractor and put fruit in it, that will produce fruit extract. After that you need to have the Infuser which takes the Fruit Extract as the Input and Vodka as the fuel source.  

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.
[*]Works in single player
[*]There shouldn't be any compatibility issues with other mods that add alcohol into the game. If there are please let me know.
[/list]

[size=5]Stay in touch[/size]

For any suggestions or questions regarding this mod, feel free to DM or @ me on the Stardew Valley Discord Server, my discord Username is DeadlyKitten#0148.
For those interested into what the roadmap looks like, you can check out my [url=https://trello.com/b/7WUcJFcA/main-board] Trello Board[/url] where I organize my mod development process, i will also be actively updating that Trello board with any new features I'm planning to add etc.
